Thanks again Madam chair for this next approval report. The administration is seeking city council approval to apply to the federal government's low carbon economy challenge fund for a city owned organics processing facility.

As work on the long term options continues, the federal government is currently in taking applications for the low carbon economy challenge fund which could cover up to 50% of construction costs for eligible projects.
A city owned organics processing facility is considered an eligible project for this fund and applications for the funding closes on February 8 of 2024.
Under regular circumstances, the administration would request a decision on the long term strategy in advance prior to applying for any funding.
However, the analysis on a long term strategy will not be completed before this submission deadline to the government's fund.
